result:
I'd make people dramatically better at distinguishing truth from comforting bullshit.

Not kinder. Not more equal. Not happier. Just less willing to lie to themselves or others when reality gets inconvenient. The ability to update beliefs based on evidence, even when it hurts, seems like the single highest-leverage change. Most of the world's recurring disasters—wars, economic collapses, bad policies, cults of personality, technological stagnation—trace back to motivated reasoning and self-deception at scale.

Everything else (technology, cooperation, institutions) tends to improve as a side effect once that core problem shrinks. The opposite—making people more empathetic or "spiritual" or egalitarian—usually just creates new ways to rationalize nonsense.

That's the one lever I'd pull.
